decisions.why: Supersorb A Ag (silver) and Suprasorb C (collagen) are advanced wound dressings.
Actico and Actico 2C are L&R's flagship compression bandage systems, the dominant products in this division.
Actilymph and Activa British Standard are compression hosiery products for venous/lymphoedema management.
Readywrap is an adjustable compression wrap system for venous disease/lymphoedema management.
